messages:
maria_cs: Quick convo 11 Crestline wants to split renewal: 60% prepaid now (wire), 40% prorated midterm. They also require KMS language in contract and their AP wants a vendor code on the PO. SOW needs a tiny appendix change. Can ops + legal confirm we can support this flow?

lee_billing: We can issue a partial invoice (pro forma) for the 60%. Need to confirm VAT handling — are they EU entity?

jordan_cfo: Yes EU entity (Crestline EU SARL). They'll wire the prepaid piece. VAT needs to be zero-rated, they will provide a VAT ID. Vendor code they requested: VC-CRST-2026.

sophie_legal: I'll add the KMS clause + reference our key-handling appendix. Also will add a short data residency sentence. ETA for redline: end of day tomorrow.

maria_cs: Perfect. @sophie_legal also flag export control line per our EU playbook.

sophie_legal: Will do.

lee_billing: For the billing entity: confirm we invoice from Redwood EU (eur-billing@redwood.com) so their AP matches. Also need remittance instructions for wire (IBAN/BIC).

jordan_cfo: We'll send remittance details when we accept the pro forma.

sam_onboard: Heads-up for enablement: Crestline requested 2x technical kickoffs + an architecture deep-dive after signing. I'll tentatively block 3x60m slots the week after funding clears.

maria_cs: Thanks Sam. I'll only confirm once docusign + payment received.

bot-docusign: DocuSign envelope created by maria_cs: https://docusign.example/ENVELOPE/crestline-2026 0status: created

lee_billing: Ops question for infra: can we stamp the PO meta with vendor_code = "VC-CRST-2026" and billing_metadata = "prepaid:60,prorate:40"? If yes I'll open a PR to our PO template.

ops_note: alex_se: I'll do the PR and attach a short migration script for accounting export.

sophie_legal: Uploaded redline: https://files.example/crestline-sow-redline.docx 0changes: KMS appendix + residency + export control.

jordan_cfo: Reviewing now. If OK we'll route for signature tonight and wire after invoice.

maria_cs: Risk: If legal redline slips >48h or finance requires additional approval, onboarding could move by 2 weeks. Marking medium risk and flagging SE to keep enablement tentative.

alex_se: Noted. I'll add a ticket to our billing tracker to auto-notify if wire not received within 5 business days of invoice.

sam_onboard: Provisional invites created (tentative). Also requested access to their SRE Slack to drop pre-read material.

jordan_cfo: All set from finance side pending signed docs. We'll push wire same day as signed invoice.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone  I'll update thread when signed + funds land. :thumbsup:
